key.name: check-interval-minutes
key.description: How often to run the update checks, in minutes.

key.name: notify-on-new
key.description: Show a desktop notification when the total update count goes up.

key.name: show-zero
key.summary: Show count label when there are no updates
key.description: If disabled, only the icon (no "0" label) is shown when everything is up to date.

key.name: sources
key.description: List of "Name|shell command" entries, editable from the preferences window. Each command runs through /bin/sh -c and its stdout is captured; the number of non-empty lines printed is treated as that source's update count. Add one entry per package manager you want tracked (cargo, npm, pipx, uv, etc.) - see the README for ready-made command snippets.

key.name: update-script-path
key.description: Path to a script (e.g. your fish update script) to run when "Run Update Script" is clicked in the menu. Leave empty to disable.

key.name: terminal-command
key.description: Command prefix used to open a terminal to run the update script interactively (so password prompts work). Adjust if you don't use GNOME Terminal, e.g. 'kgx --' or 'konsole -e'.
